RobotsTxtUseDefaults.description: Serve generated default rules when MediaWiki:Robots.txt is missing or empty. If false, an allow-all file is served instead.

RobotsTxtCacheMaxAge.description: Cache lifetime in seconds sent in the Cache-Control header of /robots.txt.

RobotsTxtSitemaps.description: List of absolute http or https URLs of sitemaps. Each is written as a Sitemap: line at the end of /robots.txt, once. Invalid entries are skipped and reported in a comment line.

RobotsTxtCentralRules.description: Rules that are always part of /robots.txt, merged with MediaWiki:Robots.txt or the generated defaults. An array keyed by user agent; each value maps a directive name (Disallow, Allow, Crawl-delay, any other) to a value or a list of values. Invalid parts are skipped and reported in a comment line at the top of the file.

RobotsTxtInheritWildcard.description: Copy the Allow and Disallow rules of the * group into the groups of named user agents, because a crawler that finds a group naming it ignores the * group. False: nobody inherits. True: every named agent inherits. A list of agent names: only those inherit.
